title: Racing joins the build catalog in the browser engine
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The browser engine now knows racing's builds as well as Tank Arena's: it lists both games, returns racing's catalog and default build, and checks a racing build with the same error codes as tank. It took one entry in the engine's game list.

Tank is unchanged: every pinned hash, replay and parity fixture is byte-identical. The browser build grows by about 7 KB, after sharing one build checker between the two games instead of compiling it twice.
